laws.rule: The Pyrénées National Park core also covers high valleys in Pyrénées-Atlantiques (Béarn). The same park rules apply there as in Occitania: no camping, bivouac only from 19:00 to 09:00 and more than one hour's walk from the core edge or motor access, no fires, no dogs, and no drone or other motorised flight below 1,000 m. The full wording is held on the Occitania page.
